fact: In late December 2023 the security ministry's director of information systems said the ministry's main courante informatisée platform was more than 80 per cent complete and would be operational by mid-January 2024; it is to replace the physical main courante registers kept at police commissariats and gendarmerie brigades, which were therefore still on paper and in no station yet digital.
title: Digital Burkina Faso – Main courante informatisée : la fin du papier pour les forces de l’ordre
